item.text: {"analysis_packet":{"certificate":"The evidence supports a deferred, policy-free handoff: preserve the contract and online boundary, treat the anchor only as behavioral evidence, and resolve scan resistance, phase adaptation, byte/object utility, and regret as competing priorities before sole policy instantiation. No executable artifact or policy rule is authored here.","witnesses":["The task requires a standard-library implementation with the specified Policy constructor and access interface.","Returned evictions must be unique integer keys that are currently cached, and capacity must never be exceeded.","The evaluator is authoritative; decisions must use only the current request and prior locally maintained state.","The objective combines object hit rate, byte hit rate, scan resistance, phase-shift adaptation, and offline-optimality regret.","The anchor uses probation/protected recency states and ghost histories, providing evidence of recency, admission, and adaptation concerns rather than a required representation.","The hypothesis identifies inherited early representation and fragmented authorship as the bottleneck; the proposed falsifier supplies no scores and therefore cannot establish improvement numerically."],"obligations":["Maintain exact interface legality and standard-library-only execution.","Enforce capacity safety for zero, invalid, oversized, and variable-sized requests without evicting nonexistent objects.","Return only currently cached, unique integer keys, and keep internal accounting consistent with every transition.","Operate online one access at a time without benchmark, trace, oracle, external-library, networking, or subprocess visibility.","Balance recency and frequency-like reuse against scans, while adapting cautiously across changing workload phases.","Account for both object value and byte cost, and minimize avoidable regret without assuming the anchor’s data structures or thresholds.","Materialize no policy in this stage; communicate a coherent charter sufficient for one downstream author to make all representation and behavioral choices."],"exact_actions":["Treat this packet as the sole downstream design brief.","First formalize invariants for membership, uniqueness, byte accounting, and legal evictions.","Define explicit behavioral priorities for hits, admissions, scans, repeated reuse, size asymmetry, and phase changes before selecting structures or thresholds.","Use only information available through prior accesses and the current (key, size, now) request.","Keep adaptation evidence bounded and prevent stale history from overriding current cache-state legality.","Have one terminal author emit exactly one complete policy artifact and nothing else."]},"artifact_kind":"analysis_only"}
